Use selective kana and English translations. Proposed illustrative sentence: 医学生は解剖で体の構造を学びます。 (いがくせいはかいぼうでからだのこうぞうをまなびます。) — Medical students learn the body's structure through dissection. Original illustration, not an attested quotation.

解剖学 かいぼうがく means anatomy; it is recognition-only here, not another required article or per-kanji metadata reading.
Keep full dictionary restrictions and primary readings separate. No frequency ranking from priority flags, no unsupported etymology, no inferred word level.
